Search official survey and census studies

Source: R/surveys.R
knbs_search_surveys.Rd

Searches the study catalogue of a supported survey archive and returns one row per study.

Usage

knbs_search_surveys(
  query = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  producer = NULL,
  access = NULL,
  limit = 100,
  source = NULL,
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

query

Free-text search. NULL returns the whole catalogue.

year

A single year, or c(from, to) for a range. Matched against the study's reference years; a study spanning several years matches if any of them falls in the range. Studies the source records no reference year for cannot match, so they are excluded with a knbs_warning_missing_metadata warning that says how many, and names them in its excluded field.

producer

Keep only studies whose producing entity contains this text.

access

Keep only these access types; see the access_type column.

limit

Maximum number of studies to return, counted after the year, producer and access filters.

source

Source id. Defaults to the first verified source that supports survey search.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to bypass any cached response.

Value

A knbs_catalogue tibble with columns survey_id, title, acronym, reference_years, country, producer, geographic_coverage, unit_of_analysis, access_type, catalogue_url, metadata_updated and source_id.

Details

Some catalogue fields — acronym, geographic_coverage and unit_of_analysis — are not carried in search results and come back as NA. They are held in the study record, which knbs_survey_metadata() retrieves. Filling them here would mean one extra request per row.

See also

knbs_survey_metadata(), knbs_variables(), knbs_survey_files()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
knbs_search_surveys("household budget")
knbs_search_surveys(year = c(2015, 2020), access = "public_use")
}
